title.zh: 查找集群内的关键连接

desc.zh: 剪线试验显示安全的网线都在环上；一次 DFS 用 low 值判断有没有回边绕过每根树边。
desc.en: Cutting cables shows every safe cable lies on a loop; one DFS uses low values to see whether a back edge bypasses each tree edge.

concepts.name: Back edges close loops
concepts.description: In an undirected DFS every non-tree edge leads to an ancestor and covers the tree path it bypasses.

concepts.name: Low-link bridge test
concepts.description: Tree edge p–c is critical exactly when low[c] > tin[p].
